<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ko">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <!-- Viewport adjusted to allow zoom for elderly users and various smartphone screens -->
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=3.0, user-scalable=yes">
    <title>세방(주) 모바일 장비가동일보 시스템</title>
    <!-- Tailwind CSS CDN -->
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
    <!-- FontAwesome Icons -->
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/css/all.min.css">
    <!-- Google Fonts: Noto Sans KR -->
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Noto+Sans+KR:wght@300;400;500;700;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    
    <script>
        tailwind.config = {
            theme: {
                extend: {
                    colors: {
                        brand: {
                            50: '#f0f9ff',
                            100: '#e0f2fe',
                            500: '#0284c7',
                            600: '#0369a1',
                            700: '#075985',
                            800: '#0c4a6e',
                            900: '#032b45',
                        }
                    },
                    fontFamily: {
                        sans: ['SEBANG Gothic', 'Noto Sans KR', 'sans-serif'],
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    </script>
    <style>
        @font-face {
            font-family: 'SEBANG Gothic';
            src: url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2');
            font-weight: 100 900;
            font-style: normal;
            font-display: swap;
        }
        * {
            font-family: 'SEBANG Gothic', 'Noto Sans KR', sans-serif !important;
        }
        body {
            touch-action: manipulation;
            -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
            transition: zoom 0.15s ease-in-out;
        }
        canvas.signature-pad {
            border: 2px dashed #cbd5e1;
            background-color: #f8fafc;
            touch-action: none;
        }
        .hide-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar {
            display: none;
        }
        .hide-scrollbar {
            -ms-overflow-style: none;
            scrollbar-width: none;
        }
        
        /* A4 1-Page Print Optimization */
        @media print {
            @page {
                size: A4 portrait;
                margin: 8mm;
            }
            body {
                background: #fff !important;
                color: #000 !important;
                padding: 0 !important;
            }
            body * {
                visibility: hidden;
            }
            #printableReport, #printableReport * {
                visibility: visible;
            }
            #printableReport {
                position: absolute;
                left: 0;
                top: 0;
                width: 100%;
                padding: 0;
                background: #fff;
                color: #000;
                font-size: 11px;
            }
            .no-print {
                display: none !important;
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body class="bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 font-sans pb-20 md:pb-6">

    <!-- App Header Bar -->
    <header class="bg-slate-900 text-white sticky top-0 z-30 shadow-md no-print">
        <div class="max-w-xl mx-auto px-4 py-3 flex items-center justify-between">
            <div class="flex items-center space-x-3">
                <!-- Authentic SEBANG Corporate Logo Box -->
                <div class="bg-white px-2 py-1 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center h-11 shadow-sm border border-slate-200 shrink-0">
                    <svg viewBox="0 0 100 40" class="h-full w-auto" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                        <text x="50" y="29" text-anchor="middle" font-family="'SEBANG Gothic', 'Noto Sans KR', sans-serif" font-weight="900" font-size="30" fill="#1c3144">세방(주)</text>
                    </svg>
                </div>
                <div>
                    <h1 class="font-black text-2xl leading-tight flex items-center gap-2">
                        장비가동일보
                        <span id="syncBadge" class="text-[10px] font-normal px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/40 flex items-center gap-1">
                            <span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse"></span>
                            실시간 연동 중
                        </span>
                    </h1>
                    <p class="text-xs text-slate-400">클라우드 공유 스마트 현장 시스템</p>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="flex items-center space-x-2">
                <button onclick="resetForm()" title="새 일보 작성" class="text-xs bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1.5 transition">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-rotate-left text-amber-400"></i>
                    <span>초기화</span>
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </header>

    <!-- Main Content Container -->
    <main class="max-w-xl mx-auto px-3 sm:px-4 pt-3 pb-6">

        <!-- ==================== 장비가동일보 작성 화면 ==================== -->
        <section id="tabNew" class="space-y-4">

            <form id="dailyForm" onsubmit="handleFormSubmit(event)" class="space-y-4">

                <!-- 1. 현장 선택 및 장비 기본 정보 Section (현장명 -> 장비종류 -> 장비번호 순서) -->
                <div class="bg-white p-4 rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 space-y-3.5">
                    <h2 class="text-base font-bold text-slate-800 border-b border-slate-100 pb-2 flex items-center justify-between">
                        <span class="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <i class="fa-solid fa-location-dot text-brand-600"></i> 1. 현장 선택 및 장비 정보
                        </span>
                        <span class="text-xs text-rose-500 font-normal">* 필수</span>
                    </h2>

                    <!-- Work Date -->
                    <div>
                        <label class="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 mb-1">작업 일자 *</label>
                        <input type="date" id="workDate" required class="w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 rounded-xl p-3 text-base font-medium focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-500 focus:outline-none">
                    </div>

                    <!-- 현장명 (1차 / 2차 선택) -->
                    <div>
                        <label class="block text-xs font-bold text-brand-900 mb-1 flex items-center justify-between">
                            <span>① 현장명 선택 * (선택 시 해당 현장 장비 자동 추출)</span>
                        </label>
                        <!-- 1차 선택 버튼 그룹 -->
                        <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 mb-2" id="sitePrimaryButtons">
                            <button type="button" onclick="selectPrimarySite('군산항')" class="site-primary-btn text-xs font-bold py-2.5 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 hover:bg-brand-50 hover:text-brand-700 active:bg-brand-100 transition shadow-sm">군산항</button>
                            <button type="button" onclick="selectPrimarySite('군산항역')" class="site-primary-btn text-xs font-bold py-2.5 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 hover:bg-brand-50 hover:text-brand-700 active:bg-brand-100 transition shadow-sm">군산항역</button>
                            <button type="button" onclick="selectPrimarySite('전주 CY')" class="site-primary-btn text-xs font-bold py-2.5 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 hover:bg-brand-50 hover:text-brand-700 active:bg-brand-100 transition shadow-sm">전주 CY</button>
                            <button type="button" onclick="selectPrimarySite('완주물류센터')" class="site-primary-btn text-xs font-bold py-2.5 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 hover:bg-brand-50 hover:text-brand-700 active:bg-brand-100 transition shadow-sm">완주물류센터</button>
                            <button type="button" onclick="selectPrimarySite('')" class="site-primary-btn text-xs font-bold py-2.5 px-3 rounded-lg border border-amber-300 bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 hover:bg-amber-100 active:bg-amber-200 transition shadow-sm">기타 (직접입력)</button>
                        </div>

                        <!-- 2차 선택 버튼 그룹 -->
                        <div id="siteSecondaryContainer" class="hidden mb-2 p-2.5 bg-brand-50/80 border-2 border-brand-300 rounded-xl space-y-1.5 transition-all">
                            <span class="block text-[11px] font-bold text-brand-900" id="siteSecondaryLabel">📍 2차 상세 장소 선택</span>
                            <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5" id="siteSecondaryButtons">
                                <!-- Dynamic 2nd tier buttons injected via JS -->
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <input type="text" id="siteName" oninput="onSiteNameManualInput()" required placeholder="현장명을 선택하거나 직접 입력하세요" class="w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 rounded-xl p-3 text-base font-semibold focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-500 focus:outline-none">
                    </div>

                    <!-- Equipment Category & No Selection -->
                    <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                        <div>
                            <label class="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 mb-1">② 장비 종류 *</label>
                            <select id="equipCategorySelect" onchange="onCategoryChange()" required class="w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 rounded-xl p-3 text-sm font-bold focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-500">
                                <option value="">-- 현장 먼저 선택 --</option>
                            </select>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <label class="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 mb-1">③ 장비 번호 *</label>
                            <select id="equipNoSelect" onchange="onEquipNoChange()" required class="w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 rounded-xl p-3 text-sm font-bold focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-500">
                                <option value="">-- 장비 종류 선택 --</option>
                            </select>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <!-- Hidden fields for equipment binding -->
                    <input type="hidden" id="equipName" required>
                    <input type="hidden" id="equipNo" required>

                    <div>
                        <label class="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 mb-1">작성자 (운전원 성명) *</label>
                        <input type="text" id="operatorName" required placeholder="홍길동 기사" class="w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 rounded-xl p-3 text-base focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-500 focus:outline-none">
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- 2. 가동계기 Section -->
                <div class="bg-white p-4 rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200">
                    <h2 class="text-base font-bold text-slate-800 border-b border-slate-100 pb-2 mb-3 flex items-center justify-between">
                        <span class="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <i class="fa-solid fa-stopwatch text-brand-600"></i> 2. 가동 계기
                        </span>
                        <span class="text-xs text-slate-400">단위: Hour 또는 Km</span>
                    </h2>

                    <div>
                        <label class="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 mb-1">작업 후 계기 *</label>
                        <input type="number" step="0.1" id="endMeter" placeholder="예: 1258.5" required class="w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 rounded-xl p-3 text-base font-semibold focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-500">
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- 3. 세부 작업 내역 Section -->
                <div class="bg-white p-4 rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200">
                    <div class="border-b border-slate-100 pb-2 mb-3">
                        <h2 class="text-base font-bold text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-2">
                            <i class="fa-solid fa-list-ul text-brand-600"></i> 3. 세부 작업 내역
                        </h2>
                        <p class="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5">버튼 및 시간 드롭다운 선택 방식</p>
                    </div>

                    <div id="workDetailsContainer" class="space-y-3 mb-3">
                        <!-- Dynamic Work Items Inserted Here via JS -->
                    </div>

                    <button type="button" onclick="addWorkDetailRow()" class="w-full py-3.5 bg-brand-50 hover:bg-brand-100 active:bg-brand-200 text-brand-700 font-bold text-sm rounded-xl border-2 border-dashed border-brand-300 transition flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-sm mb-3">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-plus text-base"></i>
                        <span>작업 항목 추가하기</span>
                    </button>

                    <!-- 작업 철수 체크 박스 -->
                    <label class="flex items-center justify-between p-3.5 bg-amber-50 rounded-xl border-2 border-amber-300 cursor-pointer active:bg-amber-100 transition shadow-sm">
                        <span class="text-sm font-bold text-amber-900 flex items-center gap-2">
                            <i class="fa-solid fa-truck-pickup text-amber-600 text-lg"></i>
                            <span>작업 철수</span>
                        </span>
                        <input type="checkbox" id="isWithdrawal" onchange="toggleWithdrawalReasons()" class="w-6 h-6 text-amber-600 rounded focus:ring-amber-500 cursor-pointer">
                    </label>

                    <!-- 작업 철수 사유 선택 하위 체크리스트 -->
                    <div id="withdrawalReasonContainer" class="hidden mt-2 p-3.5 bg-amber-100/70 rounded-xl border-2 border-amber-300 space-y-2.5">
                        <label class="block text-xs font-bold text-amber-900 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                            <i class="fa-solid fa-circle-exclamation text-amber-600"></i> 철수 사유 선택 (중복 체크 가능)
                        </label>
                        <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs font-bold text-slate-800">
                            <label class="flex items-center gap-2 p-2.5 bg-white rounded-lg border border-amber-300 cursor-pointer active:bg-amber-50">
                                <input type="checkbox" name="withdrawalReason" value="본선 완료" class="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 rounded focus:ring-amber-500">
                                <span>🚢 본선 완료</span>
                            </label>
                            <label class="flex items-center gap-2 p-2.5 bg-white rounded-lg border border-amber-300 cursor-pointer active:bg-amber-50">
                                <input type="checkbox" name="withdrawalReason" value="강풍" class="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 rounded focus:ring-amber-500">
                                <span>💨 강풍</span>
                            </label>
                            <label class="flex items-center gap-2 p-2.5 bg-white rounded-lg border border-amber-300 cursor-pointer active:bg-amber-50">
                                <input type="checkbox" name="withdrawalReason" value="우천" class="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 rounded focus:ring-amber-500">
                                <span>🌧️ 우천</span>
                            </label>
                            <label class="flex items-center gap-2 p-2.5 bg-white rounded-lg border border-amber-300 cursor-pointer active:bg-amber-50">
                                <input type="checkbox" name="withdrawalReason" value="강설" class="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 rounded focus:ring-amber-500">
                                <span>❄️ 강설</span>
                            </label>
                            <label class="flex items-center gap-2 p-2.5 bg-white rounded-lg border border-amber-300 cursor-pointer active:bg-amber-50">
                                <input type="checkbox" id="chkWithdrawalOther" name="withdrawalReason" value="기타" onchange="toggleWithdrawalOtherText()" class="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 rounded focus:ring-amber-500">
                                <span>📝 기타</span>
                            </label>
                        </div>
                        <input type="text" id="withdrawalOtherInput" placeholder="기타 사유를 입력하세요 (예: 현장 사정 등)" class="hidden w-full bg-white border border-amber-300 rounded-xl p-3 text-xs text-slate-800 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-500">

                        <label class="block text-xs font-bold text-amber-900 flex items-center gap-1.5 pt-1">
                            <i class="fa-solid fa-clock text-amber-600"></i> 철수 시간
                        </label>
                        <div class="bg-white p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-amber-300 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 w-fit">
                            <select id="withdrawalH" onchange="syncWithdrawalTimeToLastWork()" class="bg-slate-100 border border-slate-300 rounded-lg p-2 text-sm font-bold text-slate-800 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-500"></select>
                            <span>:</span>
                            <select id="withdrawalM" onchange="syncWithdrawalTimeToLastWork()" class="bg-slate-100 border border-slate-300 rounded-lg p-2 text-sm font-bold text-slate-800 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-500"></select>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- 4. 주유 내역 Section -->
                <div class="bg-white p-4 rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200">
                    <h2 class="text-base font-bold text-slate-800 border-b border-slate-100 pb-2 mb-3 flex items-center gap-2">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-gas-pump text-brand-600"></i> 4. 주유 내역
                    </h2>

                    <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                        <div>
                            <label class="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 mb-1">경유 주유량 (L)</label>
                            <input type="number" id="fuelDiesel" placeholder="0" class="w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 rounded-xl p-3 text-base focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-500">
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <label class="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 mb-1">요소수 주입량 (L)</label>
                            <input type="number" id="fuelUrea" placeholder="0" class="w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 rounded-xl p-3 text-base focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-500">
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- 5. 장비 점검사항 Section -->
                <div class="bg-white p-4 rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200">
                    <h2 class="text-base font-bold text-slate-800 border-b border-slate-100 pb-2 mb-3 flex items-center justify-between">
                        <span class="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <i class="fa-solid fa-clipboard-check text-brand-600"></i> 5. 장비 점검사항
                        </span>
                        <span id="equipChecklistTag" class="text-xs bg-brand-100 text-brand-700 font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded">일반장비 점검표</span>
                    </h2>

                    <label class="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 mb-2 flex items-center justify-between">
                        <span>일일 장비 안전점검 (불량 체크)</span>
                        <span class="text-[11px] font-normal text-slate-400">장비종류 선택 시 맞춤항목 자동전환</span>
                    </label>
                    <div id="dynamicChecklistContainer" class="flex flex-col space-y-2 bg-slate-50 p-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200">
                        <!-- Dynamic Inspection Items Inserted via JS -->
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- 6. 특이사항 및 전자서명 Section -->
                <div class="bg-white p-4 rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200">
                    <h2 class="text-base font-bold text-slate-800 border-b border-slate-100 pb-2 mb-3 flex items-center gap-2">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-signature text-brand-600"></i> 6. 특이사항 및 운전원 서명
                    </h2>

                    <div class="space-y-3">
                        <div>
                            <label class="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 mb-1">고장, 정비 또는 이상 특이사항</label>
                            <textarea id="remarks" rows="2" placeholder="정비 필요 부위, 현장 특이사항, 대기 사유 등 작성" class="w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 rounded-xl p-3 text-base focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-500"></textarea>
                        </div>

                        <!-- Signature Pad -->
                        <div>
                            <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
                                <label class="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600">작성자(운전원) 전자 서명 *</label>
                                <button type="button" onclick="clearSignature()" class="text-xs text-rose-600 hover:text-rose-800 flex items-center gap-1 font-medium">
                                    <i class="fa-solid fa-eraser"></i> 서명 지우기
                                </button>
                            </div>
                            <div class="relative w-full">
                                <canvas id="sigCanvas" width="450" height="130" class="signature-pad w-full rounded-xl"></canvas>
                                <div id="sigPlaceholder" class="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center text-slate-400 text-xs">
                                    여기에 손가락이나 펜으로 서명하세요
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- Submit Button -->
                <div class="pt-2 pb-6 flex gap-3">
                    <button type="submit" id="submitBtn" class="flex-1 bg-brand-600 hover:bg-brand-700 active:bg-brand-800 text-white font-bold py-4 px-4 rounded-xl shadow-lg transition flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-base">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-cloud-arrow-up text-lg"></i>
                        <span>가동일보 제출 (클라우드 동기화 및 저장)</span>
                    </button>
                </div>

            </form>
        </section>

    </main>

    <!-- Detail View & Print & Excel Export Modal -->
    <div id="detailModal" class="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-sm z-50 hidden flex items-center justify-center p-3 overflow-y-auto">
        <div class="bg-white w-full max-w-xl rounded-2xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col">
            <!-- Modal Header -->
            <div class="bg-slate-900 text-white px-5 py-3.5 flex items-center justify-between no-print">
                <h3 class="font-bold text-base flex items-center gap-2">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-file-contract text-amber-400"></i> 장비가동일보 제출 결과
                </h3>
                <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <button onclick="window.print()" class="bg-brand-600 hover:bg-brand-500 text-white text-xs font-bold px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-1 transition">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-print"></i> 인쇄
                    </button>
                    <button onclick="closeModal()" class="text-slate-400 hover:text-white p-1 text-lg">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-xmark"></i>
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Printable Report Body (A4 1-Page Optimized) -->
            <div class="p-4 sm:p-6 overflow-y-auto flex-1 bg-white" id="printableReport">
                <!-- Dynamic Content Injected Here via JS -->
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Floating Accessibility Zoom Controller -->
    <div class="fixed bottom-5 right-3 z-40 bg-slate-900/95 text-white p-1.5 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1.5 no-print backdrop-blur-md">
        <button type="button" onclick="adjustZoom(-0.1)" title="화면 축소" class="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 active:bg-slate-600 text-base font-bold flex items-center justify-center transition border border-slate-600 active:scale-95">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-minus text-amber-400"></i>
        </button>
        <button type="button" onclick="resetZoom()" title="기본 크기 복원" class="px-2.5 h-10 rounded-xl bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-xs font-black flex items-center justify-center transition border border-slate-600 active:scale-95">
            <span id="zoomLevelLabel" class="text-amber-300 font-extrabold text-xs">100%</span>
        </button>
        <button type="button" onclick="adjustZoom(0.1)" title="화면 확대" class="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-brand-600 hover:bg-brand-500 active:bg-brand-700 text-base font-bold flex items-center justify-center transition border border-brand-400 active:scale-95 shadow-md">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-plus text-white text-lg"></i>
        </button>
    </div>

    <!-- Notification Toast -->
    <div id="toast" class="fixed bottom-5 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-50 bg-slate-900 text-white px-4 py-3 rounded-xl shadow-xl hidden flex items-center gap-2.5 text-xs font-semibold">
        <i id="toastIcon" class="fa-solid fa-circle-check text-emerald-400 text-sm"></i>
        <span id="toastMsg">처리되었습니다.</span>
    </div>

        const GOOGLE_SCRIPT_URL = 'https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycby0XxEgzKlb1V5_x7v1DUUYS8q1-UaCNmEvpEh3gEOnp82Ms5UFlS-K_yHhJaA_Gc08/exec'; 

        // Code.gs와 반드시 동일하게 맞춰야 하는 값 (세부 작업/점검 항목 최대 개수)
        const MAX_WORK_ROWS = 8;
        const MAX_CHECK_ITEMS = 10;

        // Screen Zoom Level State for Poor Sight Accessibility
        let currentZoomLevel = 1.0;

        function adjustZoom(delta) {
            currentZoomLevel = Math.min(Math.max(0.8, currentZoomLevel + delta), 1.6);
            applyZoom();
        }

        function resetZoom() {
            currentZoomLevel = 1.0;
            applyZoom();
        }

        function applyZoom() {
            const zoomLabel = document.getElementById('zoomLevelLabel');
            if (zoomLabel) {
                zoomLabel.innerText = Math.round(currentZoomLevel * 100) + '%';
            }
            document.body.style.zoom = currentZoomLevel;
            setTimeout(resizeCanvas, 100);
        }

            { site: "완주물류센터", category: "삼방향지게차", equipNo: "5301", equipName: "삼방향지게차", operator: "" },
            { site: "완주물류센터", category: "삼방향지게차", equipNo: "5302", equipName: "삼방향지게차", operator: "" }
        ];

        // 1차 현장 선택 핸들러
        function selectPrimarySite(site) {
            currentPrimarySite = site;
            const siteInput = document.getElementById('siteName');
            const secondaryContainer = document.getElementById('siteSecondaryContainer');
            const secondaryButtons = document.getElementById('siteSecondaryButtons');
            const secondaryLabel = document.getElementById('siteSecondaryLabel');

            if (site === '') {
                siteInput.value = '';
                siteInput.focus();
                if (secondaryContainer) secondaryContainer.classList.add('hidden');
                updateCategoryDropdownForSite('');
                showToast('현장명을 직접 입력해주세요.');
                return;
            }

            if (subSitesMap[site]) {
                siteInput.value = site;
                if (secondaryContainer && secondaryButtons) {
                    secondaryContainer.classList.remove('hidden');
                    secondaryLabel.textContent = `📍 ${site} 상세 장소 선택 (2차)`;
                    secondaryButtons.innerHTML = subSitesMap[site].map(sub => `
                        <button type="button" onclick="selectSecondarySite('${sub}')" class="site-sub-btn text-xs font-extrabold py-2 px-3 rounded-lg border-2 border-brand-400 bg-white text-brand-900 hover:bg-brand-600 hover:text-white active:bg-brand-700 transition shadow-sm">
                            ${sub}
                        </button>
                    `).join('');
                }
                showToast(`[${site}] 선택됨. 아래에서 2차 상세 장소를 선택하세요.`);
            } else {
                siteInput.value = site;
                if (secondaryContainer) secondaryContainer.classList.add('hidden');
                showToast(`현장명 [${site}] 선택 완료`);
            }

            updateCategoryDropdownForSite(siteInput.value);
        }

        // 2차 현장 상세 선택 핸들러
        function selectSecondarySite(subSite) {
            const siteInput = document.getElementById('siteName');
            if (!currentPrimarySite) currentPrimarySite = '군산항';
            siteInput.value = `${currentPrimarySite} ${subSite}`;

            document.querySelectorAll('.site-sub-btn').forEach(btn => {
                if (btn.textContent.trim() === subSite) {
                    btn.className = 'site-sub-btn text-xs font-extrabold py-2 px-3 rounded-lg border-2 border-brand-600 bg-brand-600 text-white transition shadow-sm';
                } else {
                    btn.className = 'site-sub-btn text-xs font-extrabold py-2 px-3 rounded-lg border-2 border-brand-400 bg-white text-brand-900 hover:bg-brand-600 hover:text-white transition shadow-sm';
                }
            });

            showToast(`현장명 [${currentPrimarySite} ${subSite}] 선택 완료`);
            updateCategoryDropdownForSite(siteInput.value);
        }

        function onSiteNameManualInput() {
            const val = document.getElementById('siteName').value;
            updateCategoryDropdownForSite(val);
        }

        // 선택된 현장명에 맞추어 장비 종류 드롭다운 옵션 필터링
        function updateCategoryDropdownForSite(siteText) {
            const catSelect = document.getElementById('equipCategorySelect');
            const equipNoSelect = document.getElementById('equipNoSelect');
            if (!catSelect) return;

            catSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- 장비 종류 선택 --</option>';
            equipNoSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- 장비 번호 선택 --</option>';

            let filteredList = fleetData;

            if (siteText && siteText.trim() !== '') {
                const query = siteText.trim();
                const matched = fleetData.filter(item => 
                    query.includes(item.site) || item.site.includes(query)
                );
                if (matched.length > 0) {
                    filteredList = matched;
                }
            }

            const categories = [...new Set(filteredList.map(item => item.category))];
            categories.forEach(cat => {
                const opt = document.createElement('option');
                opt.value = cat;
                opt.textContent = cat;
                catSelect.appendChild(opt);
            });

            if (categories.length === 1) {
                catSelect.value = categories[0];
                onCategoryChange();
            } else {
                updateChecklistForCategory("기타");
            }
        }

        // 장비 종류 변경 시 해당하는 장비 번호 드롭다운 채우기
        function onCategoryChange() {
            const selectedSite = document.getElementById('siteName').value;
            const selectedCat = document.getElementById('equipCategorySelect').value;
            const equipNoSelect = document.getElementById('equipNoSelect');

            equipNoSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- 장비 번호 선택 --</option>';

            if (!selectedCat) {
                updateChecklistForCategory("기타");
                return;
            }

            let filteredFleet = fleetData.filter(item => item.category === selectedCat);

            if (selectedSite) {
                const siteMatched = filteredFleet.filter(item => 
                    selectedSite.includes(item.site) || item.site.includes(selectedSite)
                );
                if (siteMatched.length > 0) {
                    filteredFleet = siteMatched;
                }
            }

            filteredFleet.forEach(item => {
                const opt = document.createElement('option');
                opt.value = item.equipNo;
                opt.textContent = `${item.equipNo} (${item.equipName})`;
                equipNoSelect.appendChild(opt);
            });

            if (filteredFleet.length === 1) {
                equipNoSelect.value = filteredFleet[0].equipNo;
                onEquipNoChange();
            }

            updateChecklistForCategory(selectedCat);
        }

        function onEquipNoChange() {
            const selectedNo = document.getElementById('equipNoSelect').value;
            if (!selectedNo) return;

            const selectedCat = document.getElementById('equipCategorySelect').value;
            const fleetItem = fleetData.find(item => item.equipNo === selectedNo && item.category === selectedCat);

            if (fleetItem) {
                selectFleetItem(fleetItem);
            } else {
                document.getElementById('equipName').value = selectedCat;
                document.getElementById('equipNo').value = selectedNo;
            }
        }

        function selectFleetItem(item) {
            document.getElementById('equipName').value = item.equipName || item.category || '';
            document.getElementById('equipNo').value = item.equipNo || '';
            if (item.operator) {
                document.getElementById('operatorName').value = item.operator;
            }

            showToast(`장비 [${item.equipNo}] 정보가 선택되었습니다.`);
        }

                { id: "chk_mh_9", label: "그랩 정상 작동 유무" }
            ],
            "RMGC": [
                { id: "chk_rmgc_1", label: "운행전 누유 및 누수 점검" },
                { id: "chk_rmgc_2", label: "엔진오일, 유압오일 등 각종 오일 및 냉각수 레벨점검" },
                { id: "chk_rmgc_3", label: "에어크리너 등 각종 필터류,라디에이터, 콘덴서 청결 유무" },
                { id: "chk_rmgc_4", label: "자동 그리스 작동 여부 확인및 작업전 각 개소 구리스 주입" },
                { id: "chk_rmgc_5", label: "호이스트 와이어 상태 육안 점검" },
                { id: "chk_rmgc_6", label: "호이스트 와이어 리미트 스위치" },
                { id: "chk_rmgc_7", label: "후크 및 안전핀 상태" },
                { id: "chk_rmgc_8", label: "전기실 냉난방기 작동" }
            ],
            "기타": [
                { id: "chk_def_1", label: "운행전 누유 및 누수 점검" },
                { id: "chk_def_2", label: "엔진오일, 유압오일 등 각종 오일 및 냉각수 레벨점검" },
                { id: "chk_def_3", label: "에어크리너 등 각종 필터류,라디에이터, 콘덴서 청결 유무" },
                { id: "chk_def_4", label: "작업전 각 개소 구리스 주입" },
                { id: "chk_def_5", label: "장비 전체 외관 상태" }
            ]
        };

        window.addEventListener('load', () => {
            canvas = document.getElementById('sigCanvas');
            if (canvas) {
                ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
                resizeCanvas();
                window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas);

                canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', startSign);
                canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', drawSign);
                canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', stopSign);
                canvas.addEventListener('mouseleave', stopSign);

                canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    const touch = e.touches[0];
                    const mouseEvent = new MouseEvent('mousedown', { clientX: touch.clientX, clientY: touch.clientY });
                    canvas.dispatchEvent(mouseEvent);
                }, { passive: false });

                canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
                    const touch = e.touches[0];
                    const mouseEvent = new MouseEvent('mousemove', { clientX: touch.clientX, clientY: touch.clientY });
                    canvas.dispatchEvent(mouseEvent);
                }, { passive: false });

                canvas.addEventListener('touchend', () => {
                    const mouseEvent = new MouseEvent('mouseup', {});
                    canvas.dispatchEvent(mouseEvent);
                });
            }

            document.getElementById('workDate').value = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
            updateCategoryDropdownForSite('');
            resetForm();
        });

        function updateChecklistForCategory(categoryName) {
            const container = document.getElementById('dynamicChecklistContainer');
            const tag = document.getElementById('equipChecklistTag');
            if (!container) return;

            let listKey = "기타";
            if (inspectionChecklists[categoryName]) {
                listKey = categoryName;
            } else {
                for (const key in inspectionChecklists) {
                    if (categoryName.includes(key) || key.includes(categoryName)) {
                        listKey = key;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (tag) tag.innerText = `${listKey} 점검표`;

            const items = inspectionChecklists[listKey] || inspectionChecklists["기타"];
            container.innerHTML = items.map((item, idx) => `
                <label class="flex items-center justify-between p-3 bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 cursor-pointer active:bg-brand-50 transition">
                    <span class="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span class="w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-slate-100 text-slate-500 text-xs flex items-center justify-center font-bold">${idx + 1}</span>
                        ${item.label}
                    </span>
                    <input type="checkbox" id="${item.id}" class="w-5 h-5 text-rose-600 rounded focus:ring-rose-500 cursor-pointer">
                </label>
            `).join('');
        }

        function resizeCanvas() {
            if (!canvas) return;
            const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
            const newWidth = rect.width || canvas.width || 450;
            
            let hasSnapshot = false;
            let data = null;
            if (canvas.width > 0 && canvas.height > 0 && !isCanvasBlank(canvas)) {
                hasSnapshot = true;
                data = canvas.toDataURL();
            }

            canvas.width = newWidth;
            canvas.height = 130;

            if (ctx) {
                ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
                ctx.lineCap = 'round';
                ctx.strokeStyle = '#0f172a';
            }
            
            if (hasSnapshot && data && ctx) {
                const img = new Image();
                img.src = data;
                img.onload = () => ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0);
            }
        }

        function startSign(e) {
            isSigning = true;
            document.getElementById('sigPlaceholder').style.display = 'none';
            ctx.beginPath();
            const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
            ctx.moveTo(e.clientX - rect.left, e.clientY - rect.top);
        }

        function drawSign(e) {
            if (!isSigning) return;
            const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
            ctx.lineTo(e.clientX - rect.left, e.clientY - rect.top);
            ctx.stroke();
        }

        function stopSign() {
            isSigning = false;
        }

        function clearSignature() {
            if (!ctx) return;
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
            document.getElementById('sigPlaceholder').style.display = 'flex';
        }

        function isCanvasBlank(c) {
            if (!c || c.width <= 0 || c.height <= 0 || !ctx) return true;
            try {
                const imageData = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height);
                const pixelBuffer = new Uint32Array(imageData.data.buffer);
                return !pixelBuffer.some(color => color !== 0);
            } catch (e) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        function getHourOptions(selectedVal) {
            let html = '';
            for (let i = 0; i < 24; i++) {
                const h = String(i).padStart(2, '0');
                const sel = (h === selectedVal) ? 'selected' : '';
                html += `<option value="${h}" ${sel}>${h}시</option>`;
            }
            return html;
        }

        function getMinuteOptions(selectedVal) {
            let html = '';
            ['00', '10', '20', '30', '40', '50'].forEach(m => {
                const sel = (m === selectedVal) ? 'selected' : '';
                html += `<option value="${m}" ${sel}>${m}분</option>`;
            });
            return html;
        }

        function renumberWorkRows() {
            const rows = document.querySelectorAll('#workDetailsContainer > div');
            rows.forEach((row, index) => {
                const titleSpan = row.querySelector('.work-item-number');
                if (titleSpan) {
                    titleSpan.textContent = `작업 항목 ${index + 1}`;
                }
            });
        }

            const container = document.getElementById('workDetailsContainer');
            const rowId = 'workRow_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 4);

            const endParts = (parts[1] || '17:00').split(':');

            const sH = startParts[0] || '08';
            const sM = startParts[1] || '00';
            const eH = endParts[0] || '17';
            const eM = endParts[1] || '00';

            const row = document.createElement('div');
            row.className = 'bg-slate-50 p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 space-y-3 relative';
            row.id = rowId;

            row.innerHTML = `
                <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 pb-2">
                    <span class="text-base font-black text-brand-800 flex items-center gap-2">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-clock text-brand-600 text-lg"></i>
                        <span class="work-item-number">작업 항목</span>
                    </span>
                    <button type="button" onclick="removeWorkDetailRow('${rowId}')" class="text-rose-600 hover:text-rose-800 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1 bg-rose-50 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border border-rose-200">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-trash-can"></i> 삭제
                    </button>
                </div>
                
                <div>
                    <label class="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 mb-1.5">작업 시간대 선택 (원클릭 또는 숫자칸 터치 선택)</label>
                    <p class="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-1.5 -mt-1">※ 근무시간은 자동 계산되며, 중식(12:00~13:00)·석식(17:00~18:00)과 겹치는 시간은 자동으로 제외됩니다.</p>
                    <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5 mb-2.5">
                        <button type="button" onclick="setPresetTime('${rowId}', '08:00~12:00')" class="time-btn text-xs font-bold py-2 px-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white hover:bg-brand-50 hover:text-brand-700 transition">
                            ☀️ 오전 (08~12시)
                        </button>
                        <button type="button" onclick="setPresetTime('${rowId}', '13:00~17:00')" class="time-btn text-xs font-bold py-2 px-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white hover:bg-brand-50 hover:text-brand-700 transition">
                            🌤️ 오후 (13~17시)
                        </button>
                        <button type="button" onclick="setPresetTime('${rowId}', '08:00~17:00')" class="time-btn text-xs font-bold py-2 px-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white hover:bg-brand-50 hover:text-brand-700 transition">
                            ⏰ 주간 (08~17시)
                        </button>
                        <button type="button" onclick="setPresetTime('${rowId}', '18:00~24:00')" class="time-btn text-xs font-bold py-2 px-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white hover:bg-brand-50 hover:text-brand-700 transition">
                            🌙 야간 (18~24시)
                        </button>
                    </div>

                    <div class="bg-white p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 flex items-center justify-between gap-1 text-xs font-bold text-slate-700">
                        <div class="flex items-center gap-1">
                            <span class="text-slate-400 text-[10px]">시작</span>
                            <select class="start-h bg-slate-100 border border-slate-300 rounded-lg p-2 text-sm font-bold text-slate-800 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-500">
                                ${getHourOptions(sH)}
                            </select>
                            <span>:</span>
                            <select class="start-m bg-slate-100 border border-slate-300 rounded-lg p-2 text-sm font-bold text-slate-800 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-500">
                                ${getMinuteOptions(sM)}
                            </select>
                        </div>
                        <span class="text-slate-400 text-sm">~</span>
                        <div class="flex items-center gap-1">
                            <span class="text-slate-400 text-[10px]">종료</span>
                            <select class="end-h bg-slate-100 border border-slate-300 rounded-lg p-2 text-sm font-bold text-slate-800 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-500">
                                ${getHourOptions(eH)}
                            </select>
                            <span>:</span>
                            <select class="end-m bg-slate-100 border border-slate-300 rounded-lg p-2 text-sm font-bold text-slate-800 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-500">
                                ${getMinuteOptions(eM)}
                            </select>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <label class="mt-2 flex items-center gap-2 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-amber-800 cursor-pointer">
                        <input type="checkbox" class="no-break-check w-4 h-4 accent-amber-600">
                        식사시간 없이 연속 근무 (중식/석식 공제 제외)
                    </label>
                </div>

                <div>
                    <label class="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 mb-1">작업 내용 *</label>
                    <input type="text" placeholder="예: 단백피(취급화물) 또는 야적장 청소" value="${desc}" class="work-desc w-full bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl p-3 text-base font-medium focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-500">
                </div>
            `;
            container.appendChild(row);
            renumberWorkRows();
            syncWithdrawalTimeToLastWork();
        }

        function setPresetTime(rowId, timeVal) {
            const row = document.getElementById(rowId);
            if (!row) return;

            const parts = timeVal.split('~');
            const startParts = (parts[0] || '08:00').split(':');
            const endParts = (parts[1] || '17:00').split(':');

            const startH = row.querySelector('.start-h');
            const startM = row.querySelector('.start-m');
            const endH = row.querySelector('.end-h');
            const endM = row.querySelector('.end-m');

            if (startH) startH.value = startParts[0] || '08';
            if (startM) startM.value = startParts[1] || '00';
            if (endH) endH.value = endParts[0] || '17';
            if (endM) endM.value = endParts[1] || '00';

            showToast(`시간대 [${timeVal}] 설정 완료`);
        }

        function removeWorkDetailRow(rowId) {
            const container = document.getElementById('workDetailsContainer');
            if (container.children.length <= 1) {
                showToast('최소 1개의 작업 세부 내역이 필요합니다.', 'error');
                return;
            }
            const row = document.getElementById(rowId);
            if (row) row.remove();
            renumberWorkRows();
        }

        // Handle Form Submission and auto open Excel / View modal
        // 점심(12:00~13:00), 저녁(17:00~18:00) 시간대와 겹치는 구간은 근무시간에서 자동 공제
        const MEAL_BREAKS_ = [[12 * 60, 13 * 60], [17 * 60, 18 * 60]]; // [중식, 석식] 각 1시간

        function overlapMinutes_(aStart, aEnd, bStart, bEnd) {
            const start = Math.max(aStart, bStart);
            const end = Math.min(aEnd, bEnd);
            return Math.max(0, end - start);
        }

        // 시작~종료 시간으로 근무시간을 소수점 시간 단위로 계산 (예: 08:00~17:00 -> 8, 중식 1시간 자동 공제)
        // skipBreak가 true면 식사시간 공제 없이 전체 시간 그대로 계산 (연속 근무 체크 시)
        // 종료가 시작보다 이르면(예: 22:00~06:00) 자정을 넘긴 것으로 보고 24시간을 더함
        function calcWorkHours_(sH, sM, eH, eM, skipBreak = false) {
            const startMin = parseInt(sH, 10) * 60 + parseInt(sM, 10);
            let endMin = parseInt(eH, 10) * 60 + parseInt(eM, 10);
            if (endMin < startMin) endMin += 24 * 60;

            let breakMinutes = 0;
            if (!skipBreak) {
                MEAL_BREAKS_.forEach(([bs, be]) => {
                    breakMinutes += overlapMinutes_(startMin, endMin, bs, be);
                    // 자정을 넘긴 근무는 다음날 점심/저녁 시간대와도 겹칠 수 있으므로 함께 확인
                    if (endMin > 24 * 60) {
                        breakMinutes += overlapMinutes_(startMin, endMin, bs + 24 * 60, be + 24 * 60);
                    }
                });
            }

            const workMinutes = Math.max(0, (endMin - startMin) - breakMinutes);
            return Math.round((workMinutes / 60) * 100) / 100;
        }

        async function handleFormSubmit(e) {
            e.preventDefault();

            if (isCanvasBlank(canvas)) {
                showToast('작성자(운전원) 서명을 완료해주세요.', 'error');
                return;
            }

            // 철수 정보를 먼저 계산 (마지막 작업 항목의 종료시간을 철수시간으로 맞추기 위함)
            const isWithdrawalChecked = document.getElementById('isWithdrawal')?.checked || false;
            let withdrawalReasonsStr = '';
            let withdrawalTimeStr = '';
            if (isWithdrawalChecked) {
                const reasons = [];
                document.querySelectorAll('input[name="withdrawalReason"]:checked').forEach(cb => {
                    if (cb.value === '기타') {
                        const customVal = document.getElementById('withdrawalOtherInput')?.value.trim();
                        reasons.push(customVal ? `기타(${customVal})` : '기타');
                    } else {
                        reasons.push(cb.value);
                    }
                });
                withdrawalReasonsStr = reasons.join(', ');

                const wH = document.getElementById('withdrawalH')?.value || '17';
                const wM = document.getElementById('withdrawalM')?.value || '00';
                withdrawalTimeStr = `${wH}:${wM}`;
            }

            const workRows = document.querySelectorAll('#workDetailsContainer > div');
            const workDetailsList = [];
            workRows.forEach((row, idx) => {
                const sH = row.querySelector('.start-h')?.value || '08';
                const sM = row.querySelector('.start-m')?.value || '00';
                let eH = row.querySelector('.end-h')?.value || '17';
                let eM = row.querySelector('.end-m')?.value || '00';

                // 철수한 경우, 마지막 작업 항목의 종료시간은 항상 철수시간으로 강제 통일
                // (화면에서 자동으로 맞춰주지만, 혹시 어긋나 있어도 제출 시 최종적으로 보정)
                if (isWithdrawalChecked && idx === workRows.length - 1 && withdrawalTimeStr) {
                    [eH, eM] = withdrawalTimeStr.split(':');
                }

                const start = `${sH}:${sM}`;
                const end = `${eH}:${eM}`;
                const time = `${start}~${end}`; // 화면 표시(인쇄용)에는 계속 범위 문자열 사용
                const noBreak = row.querySelector('.no-break-check')?.checked || false;
                const hours = calcWorkHours_(sH, sM, eH, eM, noBreak);

                const desc = row.querySelector('.work-desc')?.value || '';
                if (desc.trim() !== '') {
                    workDetailsList.push({ time, start, end, desc, hours, noBreak });
                }
            });

            const checkInputs = document.querySelectorAll('#dynamicChecklistContainer input[type="checkbox"]');
            const checkResults = [];
            checkInputs.forEach(chk => {
                const labelText = chk.closest('label')?.innerText.replace(/\d+/, '').trim() || chk.id;
                checkResults.push({
                    label: labelText,
                    isDefective: chk.checked,
                    passed: !chk.checked
                });
            });

            const endM = parseFloat(document.getElementById('endMeter').value) || 0;

            const docId = 'LOG_' + Date.now();
            const logEntry = {
                id: docId,
                createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
                workDate: document.getElementById('workDate').value,
                siteName: document.getElementById('siteName').value.trim(),
                equipName: document.getElementById('equipName').value.trim(),
                equipNo: document.getElementById('equipNo').value.trim(),
                operatorName: document.getElementById('operatorName').value.trim(),
                endMeter: endM,
                workDetails: workDetailsList,
                isWithdrawal: isWithdrawalChecked,
                withdrawalReasons: withdrawalReasonsStr,
                withdrawalTime: withdrawalTimeStr,
                fuelDiesel: parseFloat(document.getElementById('fuelDiesel').value) || 0,
                fuelUrea: parseFloat(document.getElementById('fuelUrea').value) || 0,
                checkResults: checkResults,
                remarks: document.getElementById('remarks').value.trim(),
                signatureData: canvas.toDataURL(),
                totalWorkHours: Math.round(workDetailsList.reduce((sum, w) => sum + (w.hours || 0), 0) * 100) / 100
            };

            const submitBtn = document.getElementById('submitBtn');
            if (submitBtn) submitBtn.disabled = true;

            try {
                // 구글 시트로 백그라운드 전송 (CORS 우회를 위해 text/plain 사용)
                // ⚠️ 세부 항목까지 모두 "셀 단위"로 나눠 저장하기 위해 payload를 완전히 평탄화(flatten)함
                //    (작업내역/점검결과처럼 배열로 되어있던 항목들을 고정 컬럼으로 분해)
                if (GOOGLE_SCRIPT_URL !== 'YOUR_WEB_APP_URL_HERE') {
                    const sheetPayload = {
                        submitId: logEntry.id,
                        submitTime: logEntry.createdAt,
                        workDate: logEntry.workDate,
                        siteName: logEntry.siteName,
                        equipName: logEntry.equipName,
                        equipNo: logEntry.equipNo,
                        operatorName: logEntry.operatorName,
                        endMeter: logEntry.endMeter,
                        withdrawalStatus: logEntry.isWithdrawal ? '철수' : '운행중',
                        withdrawalReasons: logEntry.withdrawalReasons || '',
                        withdrawalTime: logEntry.withdrawalTime || '',
                        fuelDiesel: logEntry.fuelDiesel,
                        fuelUrea: logEntry.fuelUrea,
                        remarks: logEntry.remarks || '',
                        signatureImage: logEntry.signatureData || '' // GAS에서 Drive에 저장 후 URL로 치환
                    };

                    // 세부 작업 내역: 행마다 시간/내용/근무시간(숫자)을 별도 셀(컬럼)로 분리
                    // 근무시간(h)은 숫자로 저장 -> 시트에서 필터 걸고 그 열만 선택하면 바로 합계 확인 가능
                    for (let i = 0; i < MAX_WORK_ROWS; i++) {
                        const w = workDetailsList[i];
                        sheetPayload[`work${i + 1}_start`] = w ? w.start : '';
                        sheetPayload[`work${i + 1}_end`] = w ? w.end : '';
                        sheetPayload[`work${i + 1}_desc`] = w ? w.desc : '';
                        sheetPayload[`work${i + 1}_hours`] = w ? w.hours : '';
                        sheetPayload[`work${i + 1}_noBreak`] = w && w.noBreak ? '예' : '';
                    }
                    sheetPayload.workExtra = workDetailsList.length > MAX_WORK_ROWS
                        ? workDetailsList.slice(MAX_WORK_ROWS).map(w => `[${w.time}] ${w.desc}`).join(' | ')
                        : '';
                    // 이 일보의 총 작업시간(h) - 9번째 이후 초과분까지 전부 합산
                    sheetPayload.totalWorkHours = Math.round(
                        workDetailsList.reduce((sum, w) => sum + (w.hours || 0), 0) * 100
                    ) / 100;

                    // 점검 결과: 항목마다 항목명/결과를 별도 셀(컬럼)로 분리
                    for (let i = 0; i < MAX_CHECK_ITEMS; i++) {
                        const c = checkResults[i];
                        sheetPayload[`check${i + 1}_item`] = c ? c.label : '';
                        sheetPayload[`check${i + 1}_result`] = c ? (c.isDefective ? '불량' : '정상') : '';
                    }

                    fetch(GOOGLE_SCRIPT_URL, {
                        method: 'POST',
                        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain;charset=utf-8' },
                        body: JSON.stringify(sheetPayload)
                    }).catch(err => console.error('Sheet sync error:', err));
                }

                showToast('장비가동일보가 본사(관리자)로 제출되었습니다. 감사합니다.');

                // Show a clean success screen to the driver (서명 포함, 인쇄 가능)
                showDriverSuccessModal(logEntry);
                resetForm();

            } catch (err) {
                console.error("Save error:", err);
                showToast('저장 중 오류가 발생했습니다.', 'error');
            } finally {
                if (submitBtn) submitBtn.disabled = false;
            }
        }

        // 일보 상세 내용을 HTML로 렌더링 (제출 직후 화면 / 관리자 조회 화면 공용)
        function renderReportHTML(item, opts = {}) {
            const banner = opts.successBanner ? `
                <div class="mb-4 p-3 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-300 rounded-xl text-center no-print">
                    <span class="text-emerald-700 font-bold text-sm"><i class="fa-solid fa-circle-check mr-1"></i> 제출이 완료되었습니다! 아래 내용을 확인하고 필요 시 인쇄하세요.</span>
                </div>
            ` : '';
            const closeLabel = opts.closeLabel || '닫기';

            return `
                ${banner}
                <div class="border-b-2 border-slate-900 pb-2 mb-3 flex justify-between items-center">
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <div class="bg-slate-900 text-white font-black px-2 py-1 text-xs rounded">세방(주)</div>
                        <h3 class="font-black text-base text-slate-900">장비 가동 일보</h3>
                    </div>
                    <span class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-600">일자: ${item.workDate}${item.serial ? ` (No.${item.serial})` : ''}</span>
                </div>

                <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs mb-3 bg-slate-50 p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200">
                    <div><strong>현장명:</strong> ${item.siteName}</div>
                    <div><strong>작성자:</strong> ${item.operatorName} 기사</div>
                    <div><strong>장비명:</strong> ${item.equipName} (${item.equipNo})</div>
                    <div><strong>작업 후 계기:</strong> ${item.endMeter}</div>
                    <div><strong>경유 주유량:</strong> ${item.fuelDiesel} L</div>
                    <div><strong>요소수 주입량:</strong> ${item.fuelUrea} L</div>
                </div>

                ${item.isWithdrawal ? `
                <div class="mb-3 p-2 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-300 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold text-amber-900 flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span>🚚 현장 철수 완료${item.withdrawalTime ? ` (${item.withdrawalTime})` : ''}</span>
                    <span class="text-amber-700 font-medium">사유: ${item.withdrawalReasons || '사유 미지정'}</span>
                </div>
                ` : ''}

                <div class="mb-3">
                    <h4 class="font-bold text-xs text-slate-800 mb-1">세부 작업 내역</h4>
                    <table class="w-full text-xs border-collapse border border-slate-300">
                        <thead>
                            <tr class="bg-slate-100">
                                <th class="border border-slate-300 p-1 w-24">시간대</th>
                                <th class="border border-slate-300 p-1 text-left">작업 내용</th>
                                <th class="border border-slate-300 p-1 w-16">근무(h)</th>
                            </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody>
                            ${item.workDetails && item.workDetails.length > 0 ? item.workDetails.map(w => `
                                <tr>
                                    <td class="border border-slate-300 p-1 text-center font-semibold">${w.time}${w.noBreak ? ' <span class="text-amber-600 text-[10px]">(연속)</span>' : ''}</td>
                                    <td class="border border-slate-300 p-1">${w.desc}</td>
                                    <td class="border border-slate-300 p-1 text-center">${w.hours != null && w.hours !== '' ? w.hours : ''}</td>
                                </tr>
                            `).join('') : '<tr><td colspan="3" class="p-1 text-center border border-slate-300">작업 내역 없음</td></tr>'}
                            ${item.totalWorkHours ? `
                                <tr class="bg-slate-50 font-bold">
                                    <td class="border border-slate-300 p-1 text-right" colspan="2">총 작업시간</td>
                                    <td class="border border-slate-300 p-1 text-center">${item.totalWorkHours}h</td>
                                </tr>
                            ` : ''}
                        </tbody>
                    </table>
                </div>

                <div class="mb-3">
                    <h4 class="font-bold text-xs text-slate-800 mb-1">장비 점검 결과 (불량 체크)</h4>
                    <table class="w-full text-xs border-collapse border border-slate-300">
                        <tbody>
                            ${item.checkResults && item.checkResults.length > 0 ? item.checkResults.map(chk => `
                                <tr>
                                    <th class="border border-slate-300 p-1 bg-slate-50 text-left truncate max-w-[150px]" title="${chk.label}">${chk.label}</th>
                                    <td class="border border-slate-300 p-1 text-center font-bold ${chk.isDefective ? 'text-rose-600' : 'text-emerald-600'}">
                                        ${chk.isDefective ? '❌ 불량' : '✅ 양호'}
                                    </td>
                                </tr>
                            `).join('') : '<tr><td colspan="2" class="p-1 text-center border border-slate-300">점검 내역 없음</td></tr>'}
                        </tbody>
                    </table>
                </div>

                <div class="border border-slate-300 p-2.5 rounded-lg mb-3 bg-slate-50">
                    <span class="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 mb-0.5">특이사항 및 고장/정비 내용:</span>
                    <p class="text-xs text-slate-800 min-h-[24px] whitespace-pre-wrap">${item.remarks || '특이사항 없음'}</p>
                </div>

                <div class="flex justify-between items-center border-t border-slate-300 pt-2">
                    <div class="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                        상기 내용과 같이 장비 가동일보를 제출합니다.
                    </div>
                    <div class="text-right flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span class="text-xs font-bold">작성자 서명:</span>
                        ${item.signatureData ? `<img src="${item.signatureData}" class="h-10 border border-slate-200 bg-white rounded p-0.5" alt="서명">` : '<span class="text-xs text-slate-400">서명 없음</span>'}
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-slate-200 flex justify-center no-print">
                    <button type="button" onclick="closeModal()" class="w-full bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 text-white font-bold py-3 rounded-xl transition shadow-md">
                        ${closeLabel}
                    </button>
                </div>
            `;
        }

        function showDriverSuccessModal(item) {
            const modal = document.getElementById('detailModal');
            const report = document.getElementById('printableReport');
            report.innerHTML = renderReportHTML(item, { successBanner: true, closeLabel: '확인 후 닫기' });
            modal.classList.remove('hidden');
        }

        function resetForm() {
            document.getElementById('dailyForm').reset();
            document.getElementById('workDate').value = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
            clearSignature();
            
            currentPrimarySite = '';
            const secContainer = document.getElementById('siteSecondaryContainer');
            if (secContainer) secContainer.classList.add('hidden');

            if (document.getElementById('isWithdrawal')) {
                document.getElementById('isWithdrawal').checked = false;
            }
            
            const wContainer = document.getElementById('withdrawalReasonContainer');
            if (wContainer) wContainer.classList.add('hidden');
            const wOtherInput = document.getElementById('withdrawalOtherInput');
            if (wOtherInput) {
                wOtherInput.classList.add('hidden');
                wOtherInput.value = '';
            }
            const wH = document.getElementById('withdrawalH');
            const wM = document.getElementById('withdrawalM');
            if (wH) wH.innerHTML = getHourOptions('17');
            if (wM) wM.innerHTML = getMinuteOptions('00');

            document.getElementById('workDetailsContainer').innerHTML = '';
            addWorkDetailRow('08:00~17:00', '');
            updateCategoryDropdownForSite('');
        }

        function toggleWithdrawalReasons() {
            const isChecked = document.getElementById('isWithdrawal')?.checked;
            const container = document.getElementById('withdrawalReasonContainer');
            if (container) {
                if (isChecked) {
                    container.classList.remove('hidden');
                    syncWithdrawalTimeToLastWork();
                } else {
                    container.classList.add('hidden');
                }
            }
        }

        // 철수 체크/시간이 바뀌면, 마지막 작업 항목의 "종료시간"을 철수시간과 동일하게 자동 맞춤
        // (철수한 시각 = 실제 작업이 끝난 시각이므로, 작업시간 계산에 정확히 반영되도록 함)
        function syncWithdrawalTimeToLastWork() {
            if (!document.getElementById('isWithdrawal')?.checked) return;
            const wH = document.getElementById('withdrawalH')?.value;
            const wM = document.getElementById('withdrawalM')?.value;
            if (!wH || !wM) return;

            const rows = document.querySelectorAll('#workDetailsContainer > div');
            if (rows.length === 0) return;
            const lastRow = rows[rows.length - 1];
            const endH = lastRow.querySelector('.end-h');
            const endM = lastRow.querySelector('.end-m');
            if (endH) endH.value = wH;
            if (endM) endM.value = wM;
        }

        function toggleWithdrawalOtherText() {
            const isOtherChecked = document.getElementById('chkWithdrawalOther')?.checked;
            const otherInput = document.getElementById('withdrawalOtherInput');
            if (otherInput) {
                if (isOtherChecked) {
                    otherInput.classList.remove('hidden');
                    otherInput.focus();
                } else {
                    otherInput.classList.add('hidden');
                    otherInput.value = '';
                }
            }
        }

        function closeModal() {
            document.getElementById('detailModal').classList.add('hidden');
        }

        function showToast(message, type = 'success') {
            const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
            const icon = document.getElementById('toastIcon');
            const msg = document.getElementById('toastMsg');

            msg.innerText = message;
            if (type === 'error') {
                icon.className = 'fa-solid fa-circle-exclamation text-rose-400';
            } else {
                icon.className = 'fa-solid fa-circle-check text-emerald-400';
            }

            toast.classList.remove('hidden');
            setTimeout(() => {
                toast.classList.add('hidden');
            }, 3000);
        }

        // Expose functions to window scope for HTML inline handlers
        window.resetForm = resetForm;
        window.adjustZoom = adjustZoom;
        window.resetZoom = resetZoom;
        window.selectPrimarySite = selectPrimarySite;
        window.selectSecondarySite = selectSecondarySite;
        window.onSiteNameManualInput = onSiteNameManualInput;
        window.toggleWithdrawalReasons = toggleWithdrawalReasons;
        window.toggleWithdrawalOtherText = toggleWithdrawalOtherText;
        window.onCategoryChange = onCategoryChange;
        window.onEquipNoChange = onEquipNoChange;
        window.addWorkDetailRow = addWorkDetailRow;
        window.setPresetTime = setPresetTime;
        window.removeWorkDetailRow = removeWorkDetailRow;
        window.clearSignature = clearSignature;
        window.handleFormSubmit = handleFormSubmit;
        window.closeModal = closeModal;
    </script>
</body>
</html>
